title: Conclude request and response closing pair
purpose: Strengthen conclude coverage by replacing an isolated conclude-response fragment with a simple request/response closing exchange using documented ACSE and MMS conclude tags.
expected_behavior: A parser should accept the release-style ACSE message types and route the embedded MMS bytes to Conclude-Request-PDU and Conclude-Response-PDU handlers respectively.
constraints_preserved: Uses documented ACSE message types 0x62 RLRQ and 0x63 RLRE.
Uses documented MMS PDU tags 0xab Conclude-Request-PDU and 0xac Conclude-Response-PDU.
Both messages keep definite BER lengths and consistent wrappers.
This is a complete closing pair rather than a standalone response-only fragment.
issue_safety_notes: Session-closing coverage only; no abort or malformed termination pattern is introduced.
